busy_waiting: It's waiting for your answer. Closing it now interrupts it.
busy_working: It's still working. Closing it now interrupts it.
busy_loop: It's running a loop. Closing it now stops the loop.
busy_server: It's running a server. Closing it now stops the server.
close_agent_detail: This quits Claude in “{where}” on {machine} and closes the tab. Its conversation stays here, and you can resume it later from its terminal page.
close_runtime_detail: This ends “{title}” on {machine}. The conversation history stays available.
archive_close_detail: Persona archives “{title}” and closes its tab and process on {machine}. Its conversation stays: restore it from Archived agents, then resume it from its terminal page.
